This checks the budget is enforced; raw telegram throughput beyond it is not independently observable from outside the process. The monitor records each outgoing telegram when the background sender hands it to knxd (not when it is queued), so these windows are the sender's pacing; on the box the bus itself can be cross-checked with knxtool (see tools/perf/README.md). A flood submitted all at once (as this scenario does, deliberately — §23.1's own 'simultaneous fades') sends its first ~15 telegrams in one burst, then another ~15 about a second later as that whole burst ages out together; a window straddling two such bursts can read a little over 15 without the limiter actually being broken — see the module docstring before treating a marginal BREACHED as a defect.
